clues.text: A Levite mother coated one with tar and pitch, set her baby son inside, and placed it among the Nile reeds.
While going down to bathe in the Nile, Pharaoh's daughter spotted it among the reeds and sent her maidservant to fetch it.
When the Jews in Damascus plotted to kill Saul, his disciples lowered him in one through a window in the wall.
In prison, Pharaoh's chief baker told Joseph he dreamed of three of these on his head, with birds eating from the top one.
Jesus said no one lights a lamp and puts it under one of these, but sets it on a stand instead.
After Jesus fed the crowd with five barley loaves, the leftover pieces filled twelve of these.
The Lord showed the prophet Amos one filled with summer fruit, a sign that the end had come for Israel.
